sources.description: Official Wizardry VI Playmaster's Guide (Sir-Tech, 1990). Pages cited as 'manual p. N'.
martydill/Wizardry-6-reverse-engineering open-source RE repo. Specifically: pcfile_editor.py field docstrings and bane/data/character_parser.py SKILL_INDEX_MAP.
Our own wpcvw.ovr / wmexe.ovr / wpcmk.ovr disassembly traces, documented in earlier finding JSON files.

renames.meaning: Monster Kill Statistic — count of monsters killed
renames.source: manual p. 23 (defines 'Monster Kill Statistic (MKS)' as kill counter displayed on Additional Character Statistics screen); asm evidence in wmexe.ovr: u32 incremented per combat kill at abs 0x43f8/0x43fa
renames.stock_values: all 6 stock chars = 0 (no kills before game start)
renames.notes: Replaces prior label 'unknown_0x10'. 'combats_won' hypothesis is NOT supported — the manual documents only MKS (kills), not a combats-won counter.

renames.source: manual p. 11 ('Personality (PER)' listed as distinct primary stat); asm: stats panel msg 0xd2 = PER, 8th in 0xcc-0xd3 sequence for STR/INT/PIE/VIT/DEX/SPD/PER/KAR
renames.notes: Was previously called 'personality' in character.ts AttributesSchema with a comment about uncertainty. Now confirmed as short abbrev 'per'.

renames.source: manual p. 11 ('Karma (KAR)' listed as distinct primary stat; manual p. 17: 'Rolling Karma' during creation); asm: stats panel msg 0xd3 = KAR
renames.notes: Was previously called 'karma' in character.ts with uncertainty. KAR starts at 0 for all races per Appendix A — rolled entirely during creation. Now confirmed as short abbrev 'kar'.

renames.source: manual p. 25-26 (AC sub-components diagram shows exactly 6 body-part AC slots + Magical AC + Encumbrance penalty/Shield bonus = 7 distinct sub-values); empirical: all 6 stock chars have these 7 bytes = [0,0, 10,10,10,10,10] i.e. +0x161=0, +0x162=0, +0x163..+0x167 = 10,10,10,10,10
renames.stock_values: For stock chars (no armor): THESUS +0x161=0,+0x162=0,+0x163..+0x167=10x5. Base 10 matches manual 'virtually naked=10' AC.
renames.notes: Our struct previously split as unknown_0x161 (2 bytes) + unknown_0x163 (5 bytes). Merging into 7-element bodyAc array. The first 2 bytes are likely acMagical and acEncumbrance (both 0 for unarmored stock chars).

new_fields.source: martydill/pcfile_editor.py: 'current load in tenths of a pound'
new_fields.notes: Was previously 'unknown_0x20'. The values are perfectly consistent with carrying capacity loads: THESUS (STR=18, Fighter) and TEMPEST (STR=13, Fighter) are the heaviest carriers. Weights in tenths of a pound: 295 = 29.5 lbs, 128 = 12.8 lbs. REFUTES the 'Rebirths counter at +0x20' hypothesis.

new_fields.source: martydill/pcfile_editor.py: same field family as encumbranceCurrent — max carry capacity
new_fields.notes: Was previously 'unknown_0x22' (previously misidentified as gold). Max capacity in tenths of a pound: THESUS=270 lbs, LYSANDR=112.5 lbs. THESUS (STR=18 Fighter) has highest capacity. ASM trace: wpcvw file+0x0e3d/0x0e78: add [bx+0x4408],ax (accumulates into +0x20 from inventory items).

new_fields.source: martydill/pcfile_editor.py: companion to inventory_count (+0x1AC) for page-2 items
new_fields.notes: Was previously 'unknown_0x1ad'. The inventory is documented as 2 pages of 10 items each per martydill's model. Our 22-slot model is compatible: first 10 slots = page 1 (inventory_count tracks these), next 10 = page 2 (inventoryCountPage2 tracks these), last 2 slots = vestigial/padding. Since stock chars only have 5 items (all on page 1), this is 0.

skills_expansion.evidence: The 14-byte 'derived_stats_block' at +0x142..+0x151 is actually skill continuation bytes. Empirically confirmed: LYSANDR(Thief) skill[15]=10 (Skulduggery), NOBAL(Priest) skill[26]=7 (Theology), TREON(Mage) skill[28]=10 (Thaumaturgy), PENTAG(Mage) skill[28]=7 (Thaumaturgy). These skill indices align perfectly with class archetypes per martydill's SKILL_INDEX_MAP.
skills_expansion.weaponry_order_caveat: The academic/physical skill slots (13+) are confirmed by class archetypes. The weaponry slots 0-12 order matches martydill but differs from manual ordering (manual: Wand&Dagger=0, Sword=1, Axe=2, ...). THESUS(Fighter) has skill[1]=10; martydill says slot1=Axe (THESUS carries LONGSWORD, so Sword would be more expected). Mark weaponry slot ordering as MEDIUM confidence pending asm read of skill-name lookup table.

inventory_investigation.empirical_result: Bytes +0xE0..+0xEF (which would be slots 20-21 in our 22-slot model) are ALL ZEROS for all 6 stock chars. Not distinguishable from an empty extra slot vs. a different field.
inventory_investigation.gap_finding: Bytes +0xF0..+0x10F (32 bytes between inventory end at +0xEF and equipment at +0x110) are NON-ZERO: repeating pattern [XX 00 02 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 20] x2. These are NOT part of any current struct field. They do NOT look like item slots (item_id would be 0 but weight bytes are non-zero).
inventory_investigation.decision: Keep 22-slot inventory model. Add JSDoc comment noting martydill says 20 effective slots per page-count; last 2 slots vestigial/padding. The unmapped gap +0xF0..+0x10F is a separate open question.
inventory_investigation.inventory_count_page2: Added at +0x1AD (all stock = 0, consistent with page-1-only data)

conflict_resolutions.ours: +0x1AB = portrait_index (HIGH confidence from ASM portrait-table access)
conflict_resolutions.theirs: martydill says +0x19C is also a portrait byte
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Keep our +0x1AB. The +0x19C byte is 0 for all stock chars; could be a variant or an error in their map. Not changing until asm evidence supports dual-portrait interpretation.

conflict_resolutions.ours: +0x19E = alignment (ASM: stats panel mov al,[bx+0x4586]; add ax,0x8c -> msg lookup)
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Trust our ASM. The stats panel explicitly uses +0x19E as an alignment message lookup. Gender/sex is at +0x1A1 (our ASM: portrait-table lookup via cs:0x526[sex*2]).

conflict_resolutions.ours: +0x24 = level (HIGH confidence from inc-on-level-up ASM in wpcvw 0xb22e)
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Trust our ASM. level_up_apply (0xb22e): inc word [bx+0x440c] is +0x24. class_change_apply resets it to 1. labeledOldLevel at +0x1af stores previous level. What martydill calls 'rank' is our 'level', and what they call 'level at +0x26' is our 'levelSecondary' which we tentatively interpret as 'max level ever reached'.

still_tbd.notes: Manual p. 22 documents 'Rebirths' as a displayed stat. The martydill encumbrance interpretation at +0x20..+0x23 refutes our 'Rebirths at +0x20' hypothesis. Rebirths counter is now unlocated. Likely in the +0x1A2..+0x1A5 block (currently 'unknown_0x1a2'). Needs ASM verification via character review screen draw code.

Non-zero repeating data between inventory end (+0xEF) and equipment (+0x110). Pattern [XX 00 02 02 ... 00 00 00 20] x2. Does not decode as item slots (item_id=0 but non-zero weight bytes). Possibly page-count headers or second-page inventory metadata.

Slots 0-12 in skill array: martydill order (Sword=0,Axe=1,...) vs manual order (Wand&Dagger=0,Sword=1,Axe=2,...). THESUS carries LONGSWORD and has skill[1]=10; martydill says slot1=Axe which is unexpected for a longsword user. Verify via ASM skill-name lookup table (likely in wpcvw or wpcmk).

bodyAc[7] at +0x161..+0x167. First 2 bytes (at +0x161..+0x162) are 0 for stock chars; bytes +0x163..+0x167 are 10. Exact ordering within the 7 slots (Magical, Head, Chest, Legs, Hands, Feet, Encumbrance) needs ASM verification from the AC update routines.
